description:
Browse the WALLNODE wallpaper archive and set wallpapers at your screen's native resolution.

The desktop client for the WALLNODE wallpaper archive. Browse the archive,
set any wallpaper at your screen's real pixel resolution rather than a scaled
one, and let it change itself on a schedule from a series, a category, an
artist, your likes or a search.

Per-monitor wallpapers, an optional matching lock screen, and a tray icon it
can live in. Signing in uses the same account as the website.
